title: iTutorGroup to Pay $365000 to Settle EEOC Discriminatory Hiring Suit
supports_claim: EEOC alleged that configured software automatically rejected women aged 55+ and men aged 60+, affecting more than 200 applicants; settlement was $365000.
limitations: Settlement announcement describes allegations and relief; no public technical audit of the underlying system was published.

title: Navigating Employment Discrimination in AI and Automated Systems - Testimony of Gary D. Friedman
supports_claim: Testimony recounts the reported Amazon recruiting prototype history (2014-2018) and cautions that iTutorGroup system may have been rule-based automation rather than trained AI.
limitations: Witness testimony is not an EEOC adjudicative finding; Amazon claim relies on external press reporting and no affected-applicant count is documented.

title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework 1.0
supports_claim: NIST AI RMF identifies employment as a high-impact context and recommends Govern-Map-Measure-Manage cycle including bias testing and human oversight.
limitations: Voluntary framework; does not constitute legal compliance or certification.

title: Law 134/2025/QH15 on Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: Vietnam AI Law effective 2026-03-01 establishes scope governing AI products including potential high-risk classifications.
limitations: Exact obligations for a specific use case depend on implementing decree and the official high-risk list.

title: Decision 33/2026/QD-TTg high-risk AI list
supports_claim: Publishes Vietnam official list of high-risk AI systems effective 2026-08-15; must be compared to exact product scope to determine classification.
limitations: A use case must be matched to the full official list text; title metadata alone is insufficient for classification.

title: EU AI Act - Regulatory Framework for Artificial Intelligence
supports_claim: EU AI Act Annex III classifies AI in employment and worker management as high-risk; publishes current staged implementation timeline.
limitations: Implementation dates and guidance documents may change; must re-verify before any EU market entry.
